skill.summary: Delegate longer user-facing text generation to Upstage Solar Pro3 while keeping the primary model for planning and tool calls. Use when drafting explanations...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of upstage-solar-delegation skill.
- Delegates long-form text generation to Upstage Solar Pro3, while keeping planning and tool use with the primary model.
- Delegation is session- and threshold-based, supporting direct Upstage API or OpenRouter routes.
- Explains setup, output handling, and rules for when and how to delegate responses.
- Includes clear decision guide and user-configurable delegation settings.
